findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Gate. Case: normal use - generating and starting a Python app applies an extension migration unrelated to company setup. This migration installs three PostgreSQL extensions, although this part promises no migration and its account-setting paths require none. The selected target also contains unrelated changes in `.github/workflows/starter-smoke.yml`, `src/forge/templates/starter-python/apps/api/tests/test_database.py`, `src/forge/templates/starter/apps/api/prisma/migrations/20261026000000_extensions/migration.sql`, `src/forge/templates/starter/apps/api/test/database.e2e-spec.ts`, `src/forge/templates/starter/compose.test.yml`, and `tests/test_database_starters.py`. These implement FORGE-DATABASE-1/PG18 rather than this part's Done-when items and exceed the permitted scope. Keep that database work in its own change.

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 4, Harm 2
The browser portion of Done-when 3 remains for COMPANYWEB, as this changed test comment acknowledges. The shared sign-in page still always renders the Create an account link (`src/forge/templates/starter/apps/web/src/features/auth/pages/sign-in-page.tsx:58`), and the sign-up page still renders its form (`src/forge/templates/starter/apps/web/src/features/auth/pages/sign-up-page.tsx:34`). The required browser report is also not checked here. The Tasks table assigns these changes and checks to COMPANYWEB, so this is deferred work rather than a blocking Not done finding for COMPANYPY.
